Title: Generally available: Azure Database for PostgreSQL

Body.Content:
The PostgreSQL minor versions 11.17, 12.12, 13.8, and 14.5 are now supported by Azure Database for PostgreSQL— Hyperscale (Citus). This new support includes multiple bug fixes and minor improvements. These new minor versions are available immediately on all newly created Azure Database for PostgreSQL Hyperscale (Citus) server groups and will be delivered as a part of the next scheduled maintenance to the existing server groups.

Learn more.
